view.name: Explorer Pro
config.startPath: Start directory. Absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. If null, uses the first workspace folder (or home folder).
config.historyMaxLength: Maximum number of entries stored in navigation history.
config.enterFolderOnDoubleClick: Enter folder on double click (re-root view).
config.persistState: Persist current directory and history between sessions.
config.openTerminalOnEnter: Open a VS Code terminal in the target directory on navigation; terminal name equals the folder name.
config.openTerminalOnFocus: Open a terminal after changing workspace focus.
config.closePreviousTerminals: Close previous terminals created only by Explorer Pro.
